svg.aria-label: Where to look first. doctor saying the timer is not installed, or that lingering is off, leads to The timer does not run; saying the names timer is not running leads to A name is slow to change. A plan row that says reap in, running a program or attached leads to A session you left hours ago is kept. A log line saying zellij not installed leads to the section of that name.
